name: shopify-cowork
description: Audit and fix Shopify stores. Skills for trust, CRO, speed, SEO, structured data, AEO, and GEO — plus authenticated fixes via the Admin API.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and fix Shopify stores from public data and the Admin API.
interface.longDescription: Shopify Cowork bundles two agent skills. store-analyzer runs a public-data audit across 8 modules: Trust, CRO, Page Speed, Technical SEO, Product-Page SEO, Structured Data, AEO, and GEO. store-fixer applies safe, reviewable fixes to product, collection, and theme data through the Shopify Admin GraphQL API, with explicit approval before every write and a rollback manifest for every change.
